verdict.rationale: WorkOS's SSO product supports connecting any SAML/OIDC IdP per customer, and its organizational model (per-connection pricing, self-serve IT admin onboarding) strongly implies each customer org gets its own SSO connection, corroborated by community praise for its SSO/SCIM 'wizard' simplifying enterprise integrations. However, the pack lacks explicit documentation of domain-verification workflows or just-in-time provisioning specifics (Directory Sync/SCIM is shown as the provisioning mechanism, but JIT-on-SSO-login is not directly evidenced). Missing for 10: explicit domain-verification docs, explicit JIT provisioning docs/config, independent hands-on confirmation of multi-tenant SSO setup.
